map.基于 Dijkstra 最短路径算法，规划展厅间参观流线（最短距离）: Based on Dijkstra shortest path algorithm, plan the visiting route among exhibition halls (shortest distance)
map.📖 查看「参观流线规划 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Visitor Route Planner
map.馆内动线设计时，以展厅为节点、通道为带权边（距离/时长），用 Dijkstra: When designing in-museum circulation, treat halls as nodes and passages as weighted edges (distance/duration), use Dijkstra shortest path algorithm to plan the optimal visiting order from entrance to exit, reducing backtracking.
map.限流/单向参观场景下，按通道权重调整路径，平衡各展厅客流、避开拥堵段。: Under flow-control / one-way visiting, adjust the path by passage weight, balancing visitor flow among halls and avoiding congested segments.
map.多目标参观（只去重点馆）时，设定起终点与必看节点，快速得到最短串联路径与总距离。: For multi-target visiting (only key halls), set start/end and must-see nodes to quickly get the shortest connecting path and total distance.
map.设展厅 A（入口）→B 通道 20 m、B→C 30 m、A→C 直连 80 m: Hall A (entrance) →B passage 20 m, B→C 30 m, A→C direct 80 m. From A to C, Dijkstra compares A→C direct 80 m with A→B→C cumulative 20+30=50 m, yielding shortest path A→B→C, total distance 50 m (better than direct 80 m). Similarly, arrange the whole shortest route "entrance → bronze hall → ceramic hall → painting hall → jade hall → exit".
map.为什么有时绕路反而更短？: Why is a detour sometimes shorter?
map.Dijkstra 按边的权重（通道距离）求全局最短，并非直线近就快；经中转节点可: Dijkstra finds the global shortest by edge weights (passage distance), not simply straight-line nearness; via a transit node the cumulative weight may be smaller (e.g. A→B→C=50m < direct 80m). Planning follows the algorithm result; intuition easily misjudges.
map.权重除了距离还能用什么？: Besides distance, what else can edge weights use?
map.可把边权设为通行时间、拥挤度或能耗，算法同样适用；若要考虑「必经重点馆」，可设其: Edge weights can be set to travel time, congestion or energy use; the algorithm applies equally; to consider "must-visit key halls", set them as intermediate nodes and solve in segments then concatenate paths, getting a constrained shortest route.
